task_contract.content:
{
  "version": 1,
  "task_id": "TASK-173",
  "expected_branch": "feature/TASK-173-administrator-password-reset",
  "areas": [
    "backend",
    "frontend"
  ],
  "playwright": [
    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.staff-reset-recovery",
      "spec": "e2e/staff-password-reset.spec.ts",
      "projects": [
        "chromium",
        "iphone-air-webkit",
        "iphone-17-pro-max-webkit"
      ],
      "timeout_seconds": 600
    }
  ],
  "runtime_stack": {
    "compose_file": "deploy/docker-compose.yml",
    "env_file": "deploy/.env.example",
    "services": [
      "frontend"
    ],
    "startup_timeout_seconds": 1200,
    "cleanup_timeout_seconds": 180,
    "readiness": [
      {
        "id": "runtime.reset-ready",
        "command": [
          "curl",
          "-fsS",
          "http://127.0.0.1:{backend_port}/health/ready"
        ],
        "timeout_seconds": 120
      }
    ],
    "smoke": [
      {
        "id": "runtime.staff-password-reset",
        "command": [
          "env",
          "TASK173_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{frontend_port}",
          "E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{frontend_port}",
          "E2E_PORT={frontend_port}",
          "npm",
          "--prefix",
          "frontend",
          "run",
          "test:e2e",
          "--",
          "e2e/staff-password-reset-runtime.spec.ts",
          "--project=chromium",
          "--project=iphone-air-webkit",
          "--project=iphone-17-pro-max-webkit",
          "--workers=1"
        ],
        "timeout_seconds": 600
      }
    ]
  },
  "manual_checks": [
    {
      "id": "manual.reset-ui",
      "description": "Сопоставить диалог с прототипом на мобильном и настольном экране и независимо проверить фокус, ошибки и восстановление."
    }
  ],
  "manual_evidence": "backlog/implementation/TASK-173-manual-evidence.json"
}

manual_checks.description: Сопоставить диалог с прототипом на мобильном и настольном экране и независимо проверить фокус, ошибки и восстановление.

requirements: repository traceability is validated for every change
